_comment: Sprite rects for the Pixel Crawler modular building kit, plus the vegetation
fixes. Run `node tools/crop-sprites.mjs` to regenerate public/assets/pixel/pcb/.
HOW THESE WERE DERIVED — do not re-eyeball them off a screenshot (HANDOFF 9.5).
Walls.png and Roofs.png defeat both blob detection and projection profiling
because the parts BUTT DIRECTLY against each other with no transparent seam:
index-atlas.mjs returns one 672-wide box for Walls at --gap=0. What settles it
is that the layout is a regular 96px grid — occupancy at x=0,96,192,... is
131-147 of 169 rows at every boundary, i.e. full, which is the signature of
abutting blocks rather than of one wide sprite. Row bands come from a row
occupancy profile and are exact. Roof and prop rects were then read off a
drawn 16px grid and CHECKED by cropping and looking (lab/buildings.html).
The wall runs are the load-bearing find: each is a 96x56 continuous FRONT
ELEVATION for one material, which is what makes an arbitrary-width facade
possible. The 96x169 frame blocks above them are hollow-rectangle demos of the
same material and are not used.

sprites._: --- wall runs: 96x56 front elevations, y184-239 measured exactly ---
--- glazed storefront runs: 96x52, y620-671 measured exactly ---
--- THE ROOFS THAT ACTUALLY READ AS ROOFS: 127x94 gables, both
sprites.__: slopes meeting at a central ridge, seen front-top-down. Isolated
sprites.__2: by cropping each 127px column separately and indexing — a single
sprites.__3: index pass merges brown and green because they abut. The 64x47
sprites.__4: 'slab' pieces below are the FLAT top face of a roof and were the
sprites.__5: mistake in the first composer: tiling them can only make a box. ---

sprites._: --- roof faces: 64x47 slabs, kept for flat-roofed blocks only ---
the 'slate' piece is really a glazed/conservatory gable — fixed shape, not tileable
--- openings and fittings. The wall runs already carry their own
sprites.__: fenestration, so the composer needs a door and a chimney rather
sprites.__2: than a full window kit; the windows below are for accents. ---

sprites._: --- vegetation: SINGLE cells. Seams measured at y32 and y64 by row
profile; the installed bush_green.webp is 43x91, i.e. three cells
cropped as one sprite, and then hue-rotated on top of that. The
rust column (x146) and olive column (x98) already ARE autumn —
same lesson as the autumn trees in HANDOFF 9.10. Grade 'none'. ---
